name: 90049 · Los Angeles, CA
findings: ZIP 90049 (Los Angeles) has 322 nonprofit organizations. 93 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 71 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90049 (Los Angeles) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
